## Summary

Resolved persistent pod evictions on worker-node-7 caused by DiskPressure due to /var/lib/containerd reaching 94% capacity. The root cause was a misconfigured kubelet setting where imageGCHighThresholdPercent was raised to 95%, preventing automatic garbage collection. Fixed by resetting the threshold to 80 in the node-config DaemonSet, restarting the kubelet, and pruning unused images via crictl.

- kubelet imageGCHighThresholdPercent
